concerns.text: T010 (Validation test) is placed in Phase 3 (US1) but depends on T009.8 (synthetic gold standard) and T016 (extraction output). However, T010 is listed BEFORE T016 in the task list. T016 generates `data/processed/perspective_features.json` which T010 consumes. A consumer (T010) cannot precede its producer (T016).

T030.2 (generate_text_reflections) depends on T030.1 (align_story_ids), which depends on T030 (generate_virtual_participant_data). The task list places T030.2 after T030.1, which is correct, BUT T032 (aggregate_reader_scores) is listed in Phase 5b and explicitly requires `aligned_reader_response.csv` (output of T030.1) AND `text_reflection` (output of T030.2). T032 is placed BEFORE T030.2 in the logical flow of the document (Phase 5b vs 5a), creating a dependency violation where the aggregator runs before the reflection data is generated.

T054 (integrate_stylometry) depends on T030.2 (text_reflection generation) and T032 (aligned_dataset). T054 is in Phase 7. T032 is in Phase 5b. The ordering is correct here, BUT T054 explicitly requires `text_reflection` column. T030.2 generates this. If T030.2 is delayed or fails, T054 cannot run. The dependency chain T030 -> T030.1 -> T030.2 -> T032 -> T054 is broken in the visual grouping: T030.2 is in Phase 5a, T032 in 5b, T054 in 7. This is acceptable IF 5a completes before 5b. However, T032 description says 'T032 MUST run after T030.2', but T032 is in Phase 5b and T030.2 in 5a. This is a semantic ordering risk if phases are not strictly sequential.

T009.8 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T007 (fetch_gutenberg_corpus) to load stories. While T007 is in Phase 2 and T009.8 is also in Phase 2, the [P] tag implies it can run in parallel with other Phase 2 tasks. However, T009.8 logic explicitly 'Load a representative subset of stories from data/raw/gutenberg_stories/'. If T007 is not complete, T009.8 fails. The [P] tag is misleading if it implies independence from T007's completion within the same phase.

T043 (sensitivity sweep) depends on T025 (matching results) and T032 (aligned dataset). T025 is in Phase 4, T032 in Phase 5b. T043 is in Phase 6b. The ordering is correct. However, T043 description says 'Load matching_results.json (T025)'. T025 outputs `data/processed/matching_results.json`. T043 is correctly placed after T025. No violation, but the dependency on T032 (Phase 5b) means Phase 6b cannot start until Phase 5b is complete, which is a strict serial dependency not fully captured by the 'parallel opportunities' section.
